work.title: Untitled (Traced Figure Study)
work.description: Mixed-media work divided into two panels: left side shows a painted figure with sweeping black ink lines over turquoise and ultramarine ground, a partially rendered face visible in ochre tones. Right panel contains faint pencil tracings of the same composition on white ground, with a small labeled box reading 'Win'.
work.composition: diptych split painted and traced halves
keywords: partial face ochre tones mixed media
